newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3900/3.3925 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3900/3.3925 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3880 to 3.3910 bid and 3.3910 to 3.3940 offer in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3900 pounds bid and 3.3925 offered. The averages compared to 3.3908 pounds bid and 3.3927 offered on Tuesday.
The central bank calculated the average exchange rate at the opening as 3.391963 buy and 3.395821 sell.
